## Privacy Policies
## Fieldlens by RedTeam
Last updated as of: 10/31/23

This privacy policy (the “Privacy Policy”) informs you of our and our affiliates’ policy with respect to the online collection, use, and disclosure of personal information on the websites owned or managed by RedTeam Software, LLC, owner of the Fieldlens Platform, or its Affiliates (“RedTeam”) and that link to or reference the Privacy Policy, including www.redteam.com (each individually a “Website” and collectively the “Websites”). As used in the Privacy Policy, the term “Affiliates” means, any other Person that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with RedTeam and the Fieldlens Platform. The term “control” (including, with correlative meanings, the terms “controlled by” and “under common control with”) as applied to any Person means the possession, direct or indirect, of the power to direct or cause the direction of the management and policies of such Person, whether through the ownership of voting securities or other ownership interest. The term “Person” means any individual, partnership, corporation, limited liability company, unincorporated organization or association, any trust, or any other business entity.

This Privacy Policy applies to information that RedTeam collects: (i) on the Website, (ii) in e-mail, text and other electronic messages between you and the Website, (iii) through mobile and desktop applications you download from the Website, and (iv) when you interact with RedTeam’s advertising and applications on third-party websites and services, if those applications or advertising include links to this Privacy Policy. The Privacy Policy does not apply to information collected by RedTeam offline or through any other means, including on any other website operated by RedTeam or any third party (including Affiliates and subsidiaries) or any third party, including Affiliates and subsidiaries, including through any application or content, including advertising, that may link to or be accessible from or on the Website.

Please read the Privacy Policy carefully to understand RedTeam’s policies and practices regarding your information. If you do not agree with RedTeam’s policies and practices, your choice is not to use the Website. By accessing or using the Website, you agree to the Privacy Policy.
YOUR CALIFORNIA PRIVACY RIGHTS

California Civil Code Section § 1798.83 permits users of the Website that are California residents to request certain information regarding our disclosure of personal information to third parties for their direct marketing purposes. RedTeam does not disclose personal information to third parties for their direct marketing purposes.
INTERNATIONAL USERS

If you are a non-US resident, please be advised that we may transfer information that we collect about you, including your PI, to a RedTeam Partner across borders and from your country or jurisdiction to other countries or jurisdictions around the world. If you are visiting from the European Union or other regions with laws governing data collection and use that may differ from U.S. law, please note that you are transferring information about you, including PI, to a country and jurisdiction that does not have the same data protection laws as the European Union. Accordingly, you consent to the transfer of information about you, including your PI, to the U.S., and the use and disclosure of information about you, including your PI, as described in this Privacy Policy.
Who is a RedTeam Partner?
A RedTeam Partner is a channel partner, who has a signed agreement with RedTeam, allowing them to sell RedTeam's solutions.

A RedTeam Partner has both existing primary service relationships and is actively seeking new primary service relationships with customers that may be interested in subscriptions for RedTeam Services.
If you are located outside the United States, your information may be shared with a RedTeam Partner to provide you with local services and support.
MODIFICATION OF PRIVACY POLICY

RedTeam may amend, change, modify, add, or remove provisions of this Privacy Policy. Any changes to the Privacy Policy will be posted on this site. You are encouraged to check this site from time to time. By continuing to access or use of the Website following the posting of any amended, changed, or otherwise modified provisions to the Privacy Policy, you acknowledge that you agree with the changes, modification, and amendments.
INFORMATION COLLECTED AND STORED AUTOMATICALLY

If you do nothing during your visit but browse/search through the website, read pages, or download information, RedTeam will gather and store certain information about your visit automatically. This information does not identify you personally. RedTeam automatically collects and stores only the following information about your visit:
The Internet domain and IP address from which you access the Website;
The type of browser and operating system used to access the Website;
The date and time you access the Website;
The length of time you spent on the Website;
The pages you visit;
The search term(s) used in our search engine; and
If you linked to the Website from another website, the address of that website.

The above is collectively referred to as “Usage Information.” The Usage Information is used to make the Website more useful to visitors, to learn about the number of visitors to the Website and the types of technology that visitors use.
TYPES OF INFORMATION COLLECTED

The Website has certain areas where you may submit information. “Personal Information,” as used in this Privacy Policy, means any information that may be used to identify an individual, including, but not limited to, your name, company name, address, telephone number, email address, and other information that personally identifies you or would permit RedTeam to contact you. Personal information does not include cookies or Usage Information.

The Websites do not target and are not intended for persons under the age of 18. RedTeam does not knowingly solicit personal information from individuals under the age of 18 or send them requests for personal information. No information should be submitted to RedTeam by an individual under the age of 18.
IP ADDRESS AND LOG FILES

RedTeam may use your IP address and Usage Information to administer the Websites, to help diagnose problems with servers, to analyze trends, to track users’ webpage movements, to help identify you, and to gather broad demographic information for aggregate use.
COOKIES

The Website may use technology called a “cookie” to collect information about how you use the Website. Cookies reside on your computer and help the Website to recognize your computer’s browser as a previous visitor. In addition, on occasion, the Website may also set a “session cookie” which helps RedTeam administer the Website. The session cookie expires when you close your browser and does not retain any information about you after it expires.
INFORMATION YOU VOLUNTARILY PROVIDE

If you choose to provide RedTeam with Personal Information by sending an e-mail to RedTeam or by filling out a form with your Personal Information and submitting it through the Website, RedTeam will use that information to respond to your message, to fulfill your request, and to assist RedTeam in providing you with information.

You may also provide information to be published or displayed (hereinafter, “posted”) on public areas of the Website, or transmitted to other users of the Website or third parties (collectively, “User Contributions”). Your User Contributions are posted on and transmitted to others at your own risk. Please be aware that no security measures are perfect or impenetrable. Additionally, RedTeam cannot control the actions of other users of the Website with whom you may choose to share your User Contributions. Therefore, RedTeam cannot and does not guarantee that your User Contributions will not be viewed by unauthorized persons.
RedTeam does not disclose, share, release, publish, disseminate, rent, or sell any Personal Information to any third parties.
COMMERCIAL SERVICES

The Websites may offer applications, products and/or services, which may be offered by RedTeram. You may you use a customer order form on the Website to request information, products, and services. The customer order form and the user registration form may ask you to give RedTeam contact information, financial information, such as a credit card number, and demographic information, such as your age or zip code.

RedTeam will use the financial information provided on the customer order form or the user registration form to bill you for the applications, products and/or services which you purchase. By providing your financial information and related Personal Information, you are authorizing RedTeam to give that information to the financial institution in order to confirm and fulfill your order. RedTeam may use a third party to process online payments and therefore you authorize RedTeam to transfer your financial information and related Personal Information to such third party to process your order.
RedTeam will use the Personal Information from the customer order form and the user registration form to fulfill your purchase. RedTeam may use the Personal Information to contact you when necessary.
THIRD PARTY SITES

While the Website may provide links to external sites as a matter of convenience, RedTeam is not responsible for any third-party website, the privacy policy of any third party website, or how the third party treats information about their users. RedTram strongly advises that you review the privacy policy of any third party websites to find out how they are using your information.
DISCLOSURE OF YOUR INFORMATION
RedTeam may disclose aggregate information about users, and information that does not identify any individual, without restriction.
RedTeam may disclose personal information that RedTeam collects or you provide as described in this privacy policy:
To RedTeam’s subsidiaries and affiliates.
To contractors, service providers and other third parties RedTeam uses to support its business.

To a buyer or other successor in the event of a merger, divestiture, restructuring, reorganization, dissolution or the sale or transfer of some or all of RedTeam’s assets, whether as a going concern or as part of bankruptcy, liquidation or similar proceeding, in which personal information held by RedTeam about its Website users is among the assets transferred
To fulfill the purpose for which you provided it, such as when you invite other companies or individuals to use the Website or any of its content or features.
For any other purpose disclosed by RedTeam when you provide the information.
With your consent.
LEGALLY COMPELLED DISCLOSURE

RedTeam may disclose Personal Information if required to do so by law or in the good faith belief that such preservations or disclosure is reasonably necessary to: (a) comply with legal process or other governmental inquiry; (b) enforce any agreements, such as the website terms of use agreement; (c) take action regarding suspected illegal activities; (d) protect the rights, reputation, property, or safety of RedTeam or that of RedTeam’s affiliates, other users, or the public. This includes exchanging information with other companies and organizations for the purpose of fraud protection.

Courts of equity, such as U.S. Bankruptcy Courts, may have authority, in certain circumstances, to permit your Personal Information to be shared or transferred to third parties without your permission.
CONSENT TO PROCESSING

By providing Personal Information, you fully understand and unambiguously agree to the transfer of such Personal Information to, and the collection and processing of such Personal Information in, the United States. Your Personal Information will be stored and processed on RedTeam’s computers in the United States. The laws on holding Personal Information in the United States may vary and be less stringent than laws of your state or country. RedTeam will use commercially reasonable efforts to hold and transmit your Personal Information in a safe, confidential and secure environment. If you do not agree to your Personal Information being transferred or used in this manner, please do not submit Personal Information to RedTeam or use the Website.
ACCESSING AND CORRECTING YOUR INFORMATION
You can review and change your personal information by logging into the Website and visiting your account profile page.

If you delete your User Contributions from the Website or if you delete your account, copies of your User Contributions may remain viewable. Proper access and use of information provided on the Website, including User Contributions, is governed by the website Terms of Use.
DATA SECURITY

RedTeam has implemented measures designed to secure your personal information from accidental loss and from unauthorized access, use, alteration and disclosure. However, the safety and security of your information also depends on you. Where we have given you, or where you have chosen, a password for access to certain parts of the Website, you are responsible for keeping this password confidential. You must not share your password with anyone.

Unfortunately, the transmission of information via the internet is not completely secure. Although RedTeam attempts to protect your personal information, RedTeam cannot guarantee the security of your personal information transmitted to the Website. Any transmission of personal information is at your own risk. RedTeam is not responsible for the circumvention of any privacy setting or security measures contained on the Website.
## RedTeam Go
PLEASE READ THIS PRIVACY POLICY CAREFULLY.

This policy (“Privacy Policy”) sets forth the privacy policies and practices of RedTeam Software, LLC. ("RedTeam Go" formerly “paskr”) with respect to the collection of the information you may provide to us and information we may collect: (a) on websites powered by RedTeam (via www.redteam.com, and all related subdomains and virtual directories) (the “Site”) and (b) any other web and mobile application-based technology platforms provided to you by paskr which links to this policy (collectively, the “Products” and “Services”).

This Privacy Policy describes how RedTeam treats your use of the Site, our Products, and our Services, including the collection, storage, transfer, sharing, disclosure and handling of your personal information (“Personal Information” or “PI” as further defined below). This Privacy Policy shall apply strictly to client information collected in the United States. Additionally, this Privacy Policy does not apply to any external websites which may be linked to our Site, Products, or Services.

By using our Site, our Products, or our Services, you acknowledge that you have read this Privacy Policy and consent to RedTeam’s privacy practices as described in this Privacy Policy. You further affirm your consent by submitting content or materials to or through our Site or our Services. If you are accessing the Site, Services, or Products on behalf of a legal entity, references to “you” refer to you as an individual, and to such legal entity.

If you do not agree with our policies and practices described in this Privacy Policy, your choice is not to use our Site, Products, or Services. This Privacy Policy may change from time to time. RedTeam will notify you of any changes to the Privacy Policy by posting the revised or updated Privacy Policy and its “Last Modified” date on the Site. Your continued use of the Site, Products, or Services after we make changes is deemed to be an acceptance of those changes, so please check this Privacy Policy periodically for updates. If we make a material change about how we treat out members’ personal information we will notify you at the email address specified in your account.
CONTACT INFORMATION

By purchasing our Products, using our Site or our Services, or providing your PI to us, you agree that we can communicate with you electronically regarding any legal, regulatory, technical, security, privacy and any administrative or consumer notification obligations that may be related to your use of the Site, the Products, and the Services. If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, you can contact us at:
Email: info@redteam
Address: 8623 Commodity Circle,
Orlando, FL 32819
SUMMARY OF OUR PRIVACY POLICY
This Privacy Policy notifies you of:
\-what types of non-personally identifiable information (“Non-Personal Information” or “Non-PI”) is collected from you when you use our Site;
\-what PI of yours is collected from you through the Site, the Products, and/or Services;
how your PI is used by RedTeam;
\-with whom the PI may be shared;
what choices are available to you regarding collection, use and distribution of your PI;

the kind of procedures RedTeam employs in an effort to hinder the unauthorized access, deletion, alteration, use, or disclosure of information you provide to RedTeam by using the Sites, the Products, and/or Services; and
\-how you can correct any inaccuracies in the PI you provide to us by using the Site, the Products, and/or Services.
INFORMATION WE COLLECT
We collect two types of information from you when you use our Sites, Products, and Services. We collect PI and Non-PI which we describe below.
NON-PERSONALLY IDENTIFIABLE INFORMATION

RedTeam gathers certain broad, Non-PI about use of the Site, our Products, and our Services, including, by way of example and without limitation, the number of unique visitors to the Site, the frequency with which you visit the Site and/or access the Products and Services, your public Internet Protocol (“IP”) address, your browser type, the referring or exit pages and URL’s related to traffic to our Site, the landing pages visited on our Site, and the pages viewed on our Site. RedTeam looks at the data regarding use of the Site, Products, and Services in summary form rather than on an individual basis. We may also combine your information with other information in a way that it is no longer associated with you and share that aggregated information. RedTeam gathers this Non-PI data so it can learn, for example, which pages of the Site or functionalities of the applicable Products or Services are the most and least viewed by visitors and which third-party websites are referring visitors to the Site, Product, or Service, as applicable. The Non-PI data helps RedTeam determine the extent to which visitors use certain parts of the Site, Products, and Services. In connection with these activities, RedTeam may use the following standard technologies to collect information:
LOG INFORMATION

When you use our Products and Services or view content provided by RedTeam on the Site, we automatically collect and store certain information in our server logs. This type of information includes details of how you used our Products or Services, IP address information described below, web pages that have been viewed by a visitor, date and time, domain type, device event information such as crashes, system activity, hardware, settings, browser type, browser language, the date and time of your request and referral URL.
PIXEL TAGS

Pixel tags, also known as beacons or clear GIFs, help RedTeam better manage content on the Site by informing it of what content is effective. Pixel tags are tiny graphics with unique identifiers, similar in function to cookies, and are used to track the online movements of web users. In contrast to cookies, which are stored on a user’s computer hard drive, pixel tags are embedded invisibly on web pages.
IP ADDRESSES

RedTeam collects and analyzes traffic on the Site by keeping track of the IP addresses of its visitors. An IP address is the unique numeric identifier assigned to each computer browser accessing the Internet. An IP address, by itself, cannot identify you personally. However, when combined with other information provided by your Internet service provider, your IP address can be used to identify the computer originating a message.
LOCATION INFORMATION

When you use our Products and Services, we may collect and process information about your actual location. We use various technologies to determine location, including IP address, global positioning systems, and other sensors that may provide RedTeam with information about nearby devices and WiFi access points.
PERSONAL IDENTIFIABLE INFORMATION

Certain areas of the Site and functionalities of Products and Services allow you to provide PI to RedTeam The PI that RedTeam collects may include your name, phone number, e-mail address, Site username and password, log-in date, and other personal information provided by you in connection with your use of the Site, Products, or Services (collectively, “Personal Information” or “PI”).

By submitting PI to RedTeam, you agree that RedTeam may use the information in accordance with this Privacy Policy, including, without limitation: (i) to provide to third-party providers including, without limitation, third-party integrators who provide you with access and use to other products and services in addition to those provided by RedTeam for the purpose of providing you the applicable Products and Services; (ii) to adapt and improve RedTeam services to better suit your needs; and (iii) to meet legal, regulatory, or contractual requirements relating to the Services and Products provided to you. If you do submit PI to RedTeam, RedTeam may share that information with third parties, including, without limitation, its affiliates, subsidiaries, and partners, in accordance with this Privacy Policy and any applicable federal or state law.

RedTeam may also use your PI in other ways, such as to provide you with information about Products, Services, and offers that may be of interest to you, to seek follow-up from you about your experiences with RedTeam, or as otherwise disclosed to you at the point of collection. You may withdraw your consent by using the “unsubscribe” link located at the bottom of such messages you receive from RedTeam, or by contacting RedTeam via email at info@redteam.com. In some instances, you may receive emails relating to your use of the Products or Services which do not have unsubscribe links. These emails are generated as an integral part of the Products or Services, and you may choose to discontinue receiving these emails by discontinuing your use of the applicable Products or Services.
By submitting PI to RedTeam, you give RedTeam permission to receive it, review it, edit it, store it and use it in appropriate ways and settings.
RETENTION AND STORAGE

RedTeam will retain your PI for as long as necessary to fulfill the purpose(s) for which it was collected and to comply with applicable laws, and your consent to such purposes(s) remains valid after termination of RedTeam’s relationship with you.
HOW WE USE YOUR INFORMATION
In addition to any of the previously mentioned uses of PI and non-PI, RedTeam may use your information collected on the Sites, Products and Services for the following purposes:
\-helping to establish and verify your identity;
\-activating and maintaining your account and general customer services;

\-contacting you to offer Product or Service updates and notices, promotional notices, and other information about Products and Services or other services available from RedTeam or its affiliates (you may choose not to allow RedTeam to use or disclose your PI for marketing and promotional purposes by contacting RedTeam as outlined in the Contact Information section of this Privacy Policy);
\-providing you with Products or Services, or carrying out the transaction(s) you have requested or authorized;
\-providing you with Products and Services in connection with other products and services which you access and use through our trusted third-party integrators;
\-responding to your questions, inquiries, comments, and instructions;

\-improving the Site, Products, and Services by solving technical problems, calculating overall usage statistics, engaging in internal marketing and promotional purposes, and improving product development and content;
\-taking good faith steps to enforce Terms and Conditions or other agreements between you and RedTeam;
\-maintaining the security and integrity of the Site, the Products, the Services, and RedTeam’s systems;
\-complying with law, or with the good faith belief that such action is necessary to conform to the requirements of law; and protecting against fraud and potential fraud.

Upon your request via postal mail, e-mail, or telephone, RedTeam will provide you a summary of your PI or the type of PI retained by RedTeam. As allowed by law and consistent with our applicable partner agreements, you may modify, correct, change, or request that RedTeam delete or update any PI that paskr has collected through the Site by contacting RedTeam via postal mail, e-mail, or telephone, as provided in the Contact Information section of this Privacy Policy.

The Sites, Products, and Services may contain links to other websites, including websites operated by non-affiliated or independent third parties. Please be aware that those sites may collect PI from or about you and Non-PI about your visit. These sites have not necessarily been reviewed by RedTeam and are maintained by third parties over which RedTeam exercises no control. Accordingly, RedTeam expressly disclaims any responsibility for the privacy policies, information collection practices, content, accuracy of the information, and/or quality of products or services provided by or advertised on these third-party websites. Moreover, these links do not imply an endorsement with respect to any third party or any website or the products or services provided by any third party. You should review the privacy policies that are posted on any website you visit before using the website and providing PI to the website. RedTeam is not responsible for the privacy policies or practices of any websites that may be mentioned in, or accessible from, the Sites.
CHILDREN UNDER THE AGE OF 13

The Products and Services provided by RedTeam are not directed to or intended for use by persons under 13. RedTeam does not knowingly collect any information from children under 13. If you become aware that your child is accessing the Site, Products, or Services, and is providing any information to RedTeam, please contact us by emailing info@redteam.com. RedTeam will take steps to remove any information provided by any child under 13 from its systems and terminate the account associated with such information.
CONFIDENTIALITY AND SECURITY

Information submitted via the Internet, including through a web page or email, is subject to interception or incorrect routing, and the Internet is not a fully secure communications channel. Please consider this prior to submitting any information to RedTeam via the Site, Products, or Services. No method of transmission over the Internet, or method of electronic storage, is 100 percent secure. Therefore, while RedTeam strives to use commercially acceptable means to protect your personal information, RedTeam cannot guarantee its absolute security.

We restrict access to Personal Information collected about you through the Service to our employees, our affiliates’ employees, our authorized and trusted third-party service providers including, without limitation, our trusted third-party integrators who provide you with access to other products and services in addition to those provided by RedTeam, or others who need to know that information in order to provide the Service to you or to conduct our normal business operations. While no website can guarantee security, we maintain appropriate physical, electronic, and procedural safeguards to protect your Personal Information collected via the Site or Service. We protect our databases with various physical, technical, and procedural measures and we restrict access to your information by unauthorized persons. We also advise all RedTeam employees about their responsibility to protect customer data, and we provide them with appropriate guidelines for adhering to RedTeam’s business ethics standards and confidentiality policies. We advise the implementation of data management and security policies and procedures by our trusted third-party service providers including, without limitation, our trusted third-party integrators who provide you with access to other products and services in addition to those provided by RedTeam. While we implement these and other security measures on the Service, please note that 100% security is not always possible. We cannot guarantee that the security measures we have in place to safeguard Personal Information will never be defeated or fail, or that those measures will always be sufficient or effective. We cannot guarantee the data management and security procedures and policies implemented by our trusted third-party service providers and integrators will never be defeated or fail. We cannot guarantee that such security measures will be sufficient, effective, or properly implemented, managed, or maintained by our trusted third-party service providers or integrators, nor can we control or enforce the implementation and use of such measures by such third-party service providers and integrators.
OUR OBLIGATION UPON A CHANGE OF CONTROL

If we sell or otherwise transfer part or the whole of RedTeam or our assets to another organization (e.g., in the course of a transaction such as a merger, acquisition, bankruptcy, dissolution, or liquidation), information such as your name and email address and any other information collected through the Sites, Products, and/or Services may be among the items sold or transferred. The buyer or transferee will have to honor the commitments we have made in this Privacy Policy.
INFORMATION FOR CALIFORNIA RESIDENTS

This section is required under California law. California residents are entitled to information about our practices regarding the sale of Personal Information. We do not sell your Personal Information. If at any time we begin selling Personal Information, we will update this Privacy Policy.

RedTeam’s reliance on manual processes for extracting specification requirements from large documents posed significant challenges:

## OUR SOLUTION
Our team designed a comprehensive AI architecture in AWS, built on a serverless infrastructure-as-code model. This robust extraction pipeline was tailored specifically for RedTeam’s needs.

* **Serverless Architecture:** Leveraged use case-optimized serverless services within AWS (Lambdas, Step Functions, S3, DynamoDB, Fargate, etc.) for automated scaling, ensuring efficient processing without manual intervention.
* **Infrastructure as Code:** Deployed using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) methodologies, allowing rapid deployment and updates while maintaining consistent environments.
* **Multi-Stage Pipeline:** Included document chunking, text extraction, Bedrock AI interpretation, and storage in DynamoDB for seamless platform integration.
* **Rigorous Testing:** A test harness compared AI-extracted results against manually verified data, ensuring accuracy and facilitating continuous improvement.
* **Fully Serverless:** The solution was built out almost exclusively with serverless

# A Better Way to Manage Construction Submittals
* [Insights](https://blog.redteam.com/category/insights/) [Solutions](https://blog.redteam.com/category/solutions/)
* August 19, 2026

Every commercial job runs on a submittal log, and on most jobs, keeping it current means chasing emails, updating spreadsheets, and asking who has the ball. RedTeam’s new submittals experience changes that. Now, your team can build the log from the spec book, standardize review workflows, and see who owns every next action in one place.
You can’t control how fast an architect turns a review around. However, you can control how quickly your log gets built, how clearly ownership shows, and how early an overdue item gets flagged.
### Understanding construction submittals
#### What is a submittal in construction?

A submittal is the documentation a subcontractor or supplier sends to show exactly what they plan to install, before they order or build it. Common examples include shop drawings, product data, samples, and mockups. The GC reviews each submittal, then the architect or engineer approves it, rejects it, or returns it for revisions.
On a commercial job, that can mean hundreds of items, from curtain wall shop drawings to switchgear product data. That’s why the submittal log matters so much.
#### What a submittal log tracks

A submittal log (also called a submittal register) lists every required submittal on the project, usually organized by specification section. For each item, it tracks who submits it, who reviews it, the due dates, the current status, and who owns the next action.
### The need: why the construction submittal process stalls
Most submittal delays don’t come from the review itself. Instead, they come from the process around it:
**Building the log by hand**
Someone copies hundreds of requirements out of the spec book, one section at a time. It takes days, and it’s easy to miss an item.
**Nobody knows who has the ball**
When the log lives in a spreadsheet, the only way to find out who owes the next action is to ask.
**A different workflow on every item**
If every submittal routes differently, setup takes longer, and reviews slip through the cracks.
**Late approvals turn into schedule and cost problems**

Nothing gets ordered until the submittal is approved. As a result, a stalled review can push long-lead items onto the critical path. It can also turn into cost. Here’s [how submittals lead to change orders](https://blog.redteam.com/how-submittals-lead-to-change-orders/) when they go wrong.
### The solution: how RedTeam’s new submittals experience works
#### Build your submittal log faster
You don’t have to start every register from scratch. Instead, RedTeam gives you three ways to build it:

1. **Extract from the specification book.** Upload the spec book, and RedTeam identifies submittal requirements and groups them by specification section. Then, review each requirement next to the source document before you add it.
2. **Import from another project.** Reuse items when you’re working from similar requirements.
3. **Add items manually.** Enter items one at a time or in bulk when you want complete control.
